about: Every Vercel project this repository deploys to (.github/workflows/deploy.yml, through scripts/deploy/deploy-targets.mjs). A deployment that is live gets every green Check on main, built in CI and uploaded prebuilt, and the content release job publishes a release only when each live one serves a /build-info.json naming the code the release was compiled from (scripts/content/deploy-gate.mjs). One that is not live yet gets nothing automatically: a manual Deploy run with preview ticked uploads a preview to its project, which moves none of its domains. Going live is flipping live to true, in the change that also makes the gate read it. tokenSecret names the GitHub secret holding a Vercel token for that team. Vercel's own Git deployments must stay off for every project here: they build without the Check, and cannot say which commit they are.
